newsitem.title: MEXICO: Citibank Mexico plans push into corporate banking.
newsitem.headline: Citibank Mexico plans push into corporate banking.

text.p: Citibank Mexico said on Monday it plans to open 15 new branches across the country during the next few years to double the amount of its outlets and stage an aggressive push into corporate banking.
The bank has already opened offices in the central Mexican cities of Guadalajara and Puebla.
"Guadalajara is obviously the first city in this project, followed by Pueblo and then another 15 cities," Jose Manuel Fernandez, executive director of corporate banking, told reporters.
Citibank plans for international expansion include Peru, Brazil, Poland, Russia, Turkey, the Philippines and Indonesia, Fernandez said.
"What we are trying to do is to enter the corporate market in a much more dynamic way," he said.
